info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Dispute Id-spec
info.description: The Dispute Management API allows users to manage disputes by facilitating the removal of specific Payment to Merchant (P2M) records associated with a given dispute identifier. By integrating this API, merchants and system administrators can maintain the integrity of their records by deleting outdated or resolved disputes efficiently. This operation is essential for ensuring accurate transaction history and compliance with financial regulations. Typical consumers include financial institutions, dispute resolution teams, and e-commerce platforms seeking to streamline their operational workflows.

delete.description: This operation allows users to delete a dispute identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). Once successfully deleted, the dispute will no longer be accessible or retrievable.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific dispute identified by the dispute reference ID. It must contain the necessary information for the deletion request to be processed successfully.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content returned.

DeleteP2mByDisputeIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the DELETE operation related to disputes. The content is a string that may contain references or identifiers relevant to the operation.

DeleteP2mByDisputeIdResponse_204.title: Deletion Response for Dispute

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the deletion response.

DeleteP2mByDisputeIdResponse_204.description: A response schema for the successful deletion of a dispute operation.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method, which requires a JSON Web Token (JWT) to be included in the authorization header of requests. The JWT serves as a means of verifying the identity of the user making the request and may also contain claims about the user's permissions.
